text:
It is mathematically impossible to increase the percentage of total spending devoted to something forever.  Literally impossible.  

Eventually, that percentage has to stabilize or decline.

But here’s what people are missing about AI spending.

Spending as a percentage of the total can stabilize while spending in actual dollars continues growing for decades.

AI CapEx doesn’t need to grow 30% annually forever to justify massive investment opportunities.

“Slowing growth” is one of the most misleading terms out there.  The numbers are still absolutely massive.
